name: Cabo Verde

elections.note: Two-round system. The Constitutional Court admitted five candidacies on 21 September 2026: José Maria Neves, Joana Rosa, Gilson Alves, Antero Tavares and Casimiro de Pina.

summary: Incumbent José Maria Neves, elected in 2021 with just over 51% in the first round, seeks a second term. Cabo Verde is one of Africa's most stable multiparty democracies.
